_meta.purpose: Curated Dew Theory shop SKUs eligible for autonomous Skin Script catalog sync. Products that are not listed, or that have sync_enabled=false, are never auto-listed or price-refreshed.
_meta.how_to_add: Add one object with product_id (Dew slug), skin_script_sku (wholesale portal variant SKU), sync_enabled=true, and the verified skinscript.com product URL. No code change required. Do not add SKUs that are not on this list.
_meta.pricing_rule: retail = wholesale × 2 when the live source omits retail. Sync updates wholesale/retail/availability/SKU only — it does not rewrite Emily-facing copy.
_meta.source: Initial eight IDs match data/products.json. Variant SKUs and product URLs match data/supplier/skin-script-portal-urls.json (authenticated portal recon, 2026-09-01).
_meta.not_a_full_catalog: This is not the full Skin Script wholesale catalog. Expanding later is a data change, not a rewrite.
